cases.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (histone H3 acetylation)
cases.mechanism_detail: The intronic SVA (known to cause aberrant splicing/partial intron 32 retention and lower full-length TAF1) is associated with decreased acetylated H3 at the exon immediately proximal to the SVA; CRISPR excision of the SVA normalized AcH3, suggesting a local chromatin effect on TAF1 expression.
cases.quote: There was, however, a decrease in AcH3 association with the exon immediately proximal to the intronic SVA, and this decrease was normalized by CRISPR/Cas-excision of the SVA.
